facts.value: Synacor, Inc. (Nasdaq: SYNC), Buffalo, New York; digital technology company (email and collaboration software, identity management, portals, advertising).
CLP SY Holding, LLC (Parent) through SY Merger Sub Corporation; Parent’s sole member is Centre Lane Partners V, L.P., a fund managed by Centre Lane Partners, LLC (“CLP”).
Financial (private equity fund; equity commitment from CLP Fund V).

$2.20 per share in cash, by tender offer followed by a §251(h) merger. Equity commitment up to $87,597,343 plus award payouts; no financing condition. Termination fee $3.5 million; no reverse fee. Tender and Support Agreements cover about 17.4% of shares.
mixed: process 3 began with Company E’s approach through director Kevin Rendino (bidder-led), which Synacor took up with a banker-run outreach (target-led)

None reported beyond the ledgered processes. Not treated as sales of Synacor: the Company-proposed merger of equals with Company B (Oct 2018–Mar 2019); Synacor’s own bid for Company D (07/01/2019), all-stock merger agreement 02/11/2020, terminated 06/29/2020.

Not met (process 1): 1 party (Company A); Uncertain (process 2): 1 whole-company party (Company C) plus 2 segment-only parties (Company E, Company F’s existing May 2018 NDA), Met if segment buyers count; Met (process 3): at least 14 parties (14 stated; with CLP, E and I at most 17)
Yes. Also other-scope bids: Company F and Company I (portal and advertising business), Company G (software and services business), Company E (35% tender offer).

facts.field: Currency and units of bid prices
facts.value: US dollars per share. Several bids have undisclosed prices (A, C, F, I); Company G’s was stated only on an enterprise-value basis as a fraction of E’s.
Liontree Advisors LLC (engaged 05/08/2018); Canaccord Genuity LLC (engaged 08/25/2019, re-engaged 01/02/2020, amended 07/30/2020 and 01/25/2021; fairness opinion 02/10/2021)
Gunderson Dettmer (outside corporate counsel). CLP’s counsel: Thompson Hine LLP.

Synacor made two unsuccessful sale attempts first. In 2018 private investment firm Company A bid and then withdrew while Liontree canvassed about 12 parties. In 2019 Company C’s cash-and-stock LOI was dropped by mutual agreement after Canaccord contacted 18 parties. In July 2020 Company E approached through director Rendino, and Canaccord contacted 37 parties, 14 of which signed NDAs; E ($2.00), CLP ($1.35–$1.41) and segment bidder G submitted by 09/17/2020, and Synacor granted E exclusivity. E later switched to a 35% tender offer, so Synacor revived CLP, which rose from $1.88 to $2.00 under an LOI signed 01/07/2021. After the Board demanded $2.20, CLP agreed and the merger agreement was signed on 02/10/2021.

cells.Recommended answer: Keep the current map provisionally. If Company B's target-proposed merger of equals counts as a sale, process 2 may begin in October 2018; do not automatically merge it with process 1, since the June-to-October gap and undated Liontree outreach need separate treatment. E5, P1→P2: (a) met, A withdrew, no IOI outstanding; (b) met on reading, about 8–9 months but Liontree end undated; (c) met, Company C NDA.
